content.english: I shall sing to the most exalted God a song in His congregation,

content.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם : בַּיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת מִכָּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ:
content.transliteration: Bayyom, bayyom asher shavat mikkol melachto.
content.english: On the day / on the day He ceased from all His work.

content.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם : בַּיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת מִכָּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ:
content.transliteration: Bayyom, bayyom asher shavat mikkol melachto.
content.english: On the day / on the day He ceased from all His work.
He formed with wisdom days and nights.
After creating the earth, the seas, and the heavens,

content.hebrew: כָּל עֵץ וְכָל עֵשֶׂב עוֹף וּבְהֵמָה
content.english: All the trees, plants, birds, and beasts,
He formed man in His image to stand in attendance upon Him.

content.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם : בַּיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת מִכָּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ:
content.transliteration: Bayyom, bayyom asher shavat mikkol melachto.
content.english: On the day / on the day He ceased from all His work.
In His Torah, God said of the Sabbath day:
Observe it and cease work. The Prophet and the Seer [continued]:
They shall not do any work, of either this type or that,
Neither their sons or daughters nor their male or female slaves.

content.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם : בַּיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת מִכָּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ:
content.transliteration: Bayyom, bayyom asher shavat mikkol melachto.
content.english: On the day / on the day He ceased from all His work.
Those who hallow the day to be joyful on it,
Their souls [will be] in a state of rest in the Garden of Eden!
You will live [again], and [your souls] will delight. But into the pit of hell
Will fall and perish the one who labors!

content.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם : בַּיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת מִכָּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ:
content.transliteration: Bayyom, bayyom asher shavat mikkol melachto.
content.english: On the day / on the day He ceased from all His work.
Business talk or other affairs
Are forbidden to be mentioned, even covertly—
Only the Torah of God and other [holy] books:
The one contemplating upon God’s delight will merit his countenance!

content.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם : בַּיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת מִכָּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ:
content.transliteration: Bayyom, bayyom asher shavat mikkol melachto.
content.english: On the day / on the day He ceased from all His work.
Praise and thanks I shall offer to my God
Who mercifully provided a day to forget my labors.

content.hebrew: זֶה יוֹם מְנוּחָה, גַּם חֵרוּת יְצַו לִי
content.transliteration: Zé yom menuḥa gam ḥerut yetsav li
content.english: It is a day of rest; but He also proclaimed my freedom,
The Holy one! We shall merit resting in His Temple.

content.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם : בַּיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר שָׁבַת מִכָּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ:
content.transliteration: Bayyom, bayyom asher shavat mikkol melachto.
content.english: On the day / on the day He ceased from all His work.
